description: LOWELL, Mass. (Dec. 3, 2019) – Today, Congresswoman Lori Trahan (MA-03) was endorsed by the Planned Parenthood Action Fund in her 2020 re-election campaign to represent Massachusetts’ Third District. “You have demonstrated strong support for sexual and reproductive health and rights, and we feel confident you will be a dedicated advocate for Planned Parenthood health […]

title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
